title: An AI assistant on your computer
heading: Put AI to work
intro: Read documents, work in your browser and automate recurring tasks. Choose your AI model and set the permissions for each job.
features: Ask your assistant to read selected files, summarize the key points and put together a list of next steps.
Set routines for familiar tasks. Choose the permissions they need and review actions that require your approval.
Pair a phone with your computer to follow tasks on the go. The computer running the assistant must stay awake and connected.
downloadIntro: Internal test builds. Select the operating system and architecture for your device.
linuxNote: This test batch does not include a Linux installer.

platformDetails.mac: Open  → About This Mac. Choose Intel for an Intel processor or Apple Silicon for an Apple M-series chip. The app requires macOS 12 Monterey or later. Open the DMG and drag StartupBot into Applications. This test build is not notarized and may prompt Gatekeeper.
platformDetails.win: Choose x64 for 64-bit Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 for Windows 11 on Snapdragon or another ARM64 processor. 32-bit Windows is unsupported. SmartScreen may show a warning for this internal build.
platformDetails.android: Test APK for ARM64 devices. Launch tested on an x86_64 emulator. Physical phones have not been verified.
platformDetails.ios: Unzip and install in Xcode’s iOS Simulator on a Mac. Choose your Mac’s architecture. Physical iPhone and TestFlight builds are not available yet.

docsBody: Install the desktop build for your computer. Open StartupBot, choose an AI provider or a local model, then create your first assistant. Try summarizing a sample file before connecting work data.
supportBody: Include your StartupBot version, operating system and steps to reproduce an issue. Remove API keys and personal information from screenshots and logs.
releasesBody: The internal test batch includes desktop v11, Android 0.1.9 and iOS Simulator 0.1.2 build 16. There is no public release yet.
privacyBody: The website uses ChatGPT sign-in to identify your StartupBot account. Each provisioned workspace has its own server origin and stores its own agents, chats and apps. The workspace pairs this browser for up to eight hours. On a shared computer, sign out of the workspace and the website. Messages go to the provider configured for that workspace. The optional OpenRouter quick chat sends the text you submit to OpenRouter and its model provider to generate replies. The OpenRouter credential is held in an encrypted session cookie that expires after eight hours. Recent turns are sent as conversation context. Disconnect here or revoke the key in your OpenRouter key settings. On-device mode is a separate option. Local chat processes messages on your device and clears the conversation on reload except for copies you explicitly save in your browser. If you choose to download the model, your browser contacts Hugging Face and may cache the model for next time. When you open your own workspace, authentication and data processing follow the settings of your host and the providers you choose.
termsBody: The builds on this page are for internal testing. Public release terms are in preparation.
githubNote: Download via GitHub Actions. Sign in with repository access and unzip the downloaded file.
macGuide: Opening the test build on a Mac
macSteps: On Intel Macs, the bundled browser and Computer Use require macOS 13 Ventura or later. The bundled Cloudflare tunnel tool requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later. The Intel build was tested on macOS 26. Earlier versions have not been tested directly. Only open a trusted internal build. After dragging StartupBot to Applications and trying to open it, choose Done if macOS says Apple cannot verify the app. In System Settings → Privacy & Security, find StartupBot, choose Open Anyway and confirm Open. If macOS reports malware or file damage, stop and report the issue.
casesTitle: What would you like to delegate?
cases: Accounting
Reconcile incoming payments
Use exported sales and bank records to find missing payments, amount differences or duplicate references.
Match these two sheets by reference and amount. List discrepancies with the original row numbers so I can review them.
HR & social insurance
Review monthly staff changes
Prepare a list of changes from two monthly rosters for your HR team to check before preparing Vietnamese social insurance filings.
Using these two anonymized rosters, list new staff IDs, departures and records with missing fields.
Shopee
Check order payouts
Work with order and settlement reports exported from Shopee to reconcile fees and refunds.
Join these files by order ID. Separate refunded orders, missing payouts and fee mismatches.
Sales
Prepare your next follow-up
Turn call notes and a customer list into drafts tailored to each sales opportunity.
Summarize each customer’s needs. Draft three follow-up emails for me to review before sending.
Marketing
Plan next week’s content
Compare campaign performance from exported reports, then draft ideas for your next content calendar.
Compare cost per lead by channel in this week’s report and suggest three content experiments.

web.title: StartupBot for web
web.subtitle: Open your workspace or chat privately on this device.
web.consent: First use downloads 1.12 GB from Hugging Face. Use Wi-Fi and keep this tab open. A compact 491 MB option is also available.
web.noCache: Ready. Your browser could not save the model for next time.
web.loadError: Could not open the model. Check your connection, close other tabs to free memory and try again.
web.error: Could not generate a reply. Please try again.
web.long: The content exceeds the model context. Send a shorter excerpt.
web.unsupported: This browser lacks WebAssembly or Web Crypto. Use a newer browser or open your workspace.
web.hostHelp: Paste the pairing link from your StartupBot workspace. Use its existing agents, history, tools and configured model. The host must be awake and reachable.
web.invalid: Enter an HTTPS workspace link, or HTTP localhost on this computer, without an embedded username or password.
web.privacy: Local chat uses a small model on your device. Messages stay in tab memory and clear on reload unless you save a local copy. This mode has no access to your files, accounts or computer controls. Double-check figures and important information.
web.noScript: Enable JavaScript to use this web app.
web.rememberHost: Remember this host on this device (origin only)
web.compactConsent: First use downloads 491 MB from Hugging Face. This smaller model can make more mistakes.
web.mathHelp: Enter an expression. Use a decimal point and omit thousands separators.
web.docHelp: Choose a UTF-8 TXT, Markdown or CSV file up to 16 KiB. Its contents are processed in this tab.
web.docInvalid: Choose a nonempty UTF-8 TXT, Markdown or CSV file up to 16 KiB.
web.confirmDelete: Delete the selected copy from this browser?
web.replaceChat: Replace the open conversation with this copy?
web.saved: Saved to this browser on this device.
web.restored: Conversation reopened. To continue, load the local model if needed.
web.storageError: Could not read or save this copy. Check browser storage or export the conversation to a file.
